title: A Weak Penalty Neural ODE for Learning Chaotic Dynamics from Noisy Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2511.06609v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The accurate forecasting of complex, high-dimensional dynamical systems from observational data is a fundamental task across numerous scientific and engineering disciplines. A significant challenge arises from noisy observations of deterministic dynamics, which severely degrade the performance of data-driven models. In chaotic dynamical systems, where small initial errors amplify exponentially, it is particularly difficult to develop a model from noisy data that achieves short-term accuracy while preserving long-term invariant properties. To overcome this, we consider the weak formulation as a complementary approach to the classical L2-loss function for training models of dynamical systems. We empirically verify that the weak formulation, with a proper choice of test function and integration domain, effectively filters noisy data. translated_title: 一种用于从含噪时间序列学习混沌动力学的弱惩罚神经ODE
translated_abstract: 从观测数据准确预测复杂高维动力学系统是众多科学与工程领域的基本任务。一个重大挑战来自确定性动力学的噪声观测，这会严重降低数据驱动模型的性能。在混沌动力学系统中，由于微小初始误差会指数级放大，从含噪数据开发一个既能实现短期准确性又能保持长期不变性质的模型尤为困难。为克服这一问题，我们将弱形式视为经典L2损失函数的补充方法，用于训练动力学系统模型。我们通过实验验证，适当选择测试函数和积分域的弱形式能有效过滤噪声数据。这一见解解释了为何弱形式损失函数类似于对滤波后数据进行模型拟合。
tldr: 本文提出一种弱惩罚神经ODE方法，通过弱形式损失函数有效过滤噪声，从而在混沌系统中实现短期准确预测并保持长期不变性质。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a weak penalty neural ODE that leverages a weak-form loss function to effectively filter noise, enabling accurate short-term forecasting and preservation of long-term invariant properties in chaotic systems.
